script.text: Good morning! I'm Kelly, and this is your daily lesson for October 27. Today we're exploring two powerful ideas together.
Drop anything, anywhere, anytime—it falls.  Energy is never created or destroyed—it just moves.  Some rules never break.

Natural laws work everywhere, every time. Gravity doesn't take days off. Energy is always conserved. This universality is what makes them laws, not just patterns. Laws enable prediction.  If something always happens, you can count on it happening.
Today's wisdom: Here's today's wisdom: Some rules are universal.  Finding them enables prediction and power.
Now let's take what we learned and put it into practice.
Today's growth challenge is Law Discovery - What Rules Never Break?.

Here's your activity: What patterns in your domain never seem to break? What can you always count on? Finding 'laws' in your area gives you predictive power. What are the reliable rules you can build on? This helps you identify consistent patterns in personal and professional domains.
And here's how today's lessons connect: What you learned about rules nature always follows can be applied to law discovery - what rules never break?. Practice makes progress.
That's today's lesson. Learn something, grow a little. I'll see you tomorrow with something new. Stay curious!
